notes: Only api/* routes are kept; the "api" middleware alias is stripped from every entry.
artisan prints middleware as fully-qualified class names. The "middleware" field holds the kernel aliases used in routes/api.php; "middleware_raw" keeps what artisan printed.
GET rows are reported as GET|HEAD because Laravel registers HEAD implicitly.
api/documentation and api/oauth2-callback come from the l5-swagger package, not routes/api.php.
